'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 John Anderson DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[John Anderson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (Virtual Block 7)|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage]]
* '''Username:''' Puck71
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
